name: kingmc-afk-bot
description: Enterprise KingMC AFK Bot & Fleet Management System

scripts.dev: node -e "const {spawn} = require('child_process'); const m = spawn(process.execPath, ['manager.js'], {stdio: 'inherit'}); const b = spawn(process.execPath, ['bot.js'], {stdio: 'inherit'}); process.on('SIGINT', () => { m.kill(); b.kill(); process.exit(0); });"
